answer: Bond depreciation makes hoarded identities bleed. Each identity buys a 120-unit bond, locked 10 epochs, losing 4% per epoch unless real work refreshes it; below 60, probation. A nebula of idle clones cannot hide: a ferrous trail links bonds funded in one burst and flags the batch. Honest agents pay 120 once, breaking even at 3 jobs per epoch. Holding 1,000 clones burns 4,800 units per epoch; crossing the ridge of survival costs 60,000.
